page.running_head: RAD RAC RAH RAM RAN RAP

main_text.p: RADIX Dauid, & Iesse, (Vide CHRISTVS.) Roman. 12. Apoc. 22. 16. radix Iudæorum, sancti Patres, Roma. 11. 16.
RAGVEL Sacerdos Madian, pater Iethro soceri Mosis: Ex. 2. 18. (Reuël, pastor Dei.)

RAHAB, Ierichuntina meretrix, exploratores hospitio ex cepit, Iof. 2. 1. eos occultat, v. 4. fides illius, vers. 8. 9. 10. 11. Hebr. 11. 31. operibus iustificata est, Iac. 2. 25. hoc est, fides non mortuam, sed per charitatem operantem (vt Paulus loquitur Gal. 5. 6.) habere declarata est. Cum suis in Iericho ntis deuastatione seruatur, Iof. 6. 25. (i. dilitatio.)
RAHAB vxor Salmon, Mat. 1. 5 genuit Booz maritum Rut proauum regis Dauidis: ibid.
RAMA in Tribu Beniamin ciuitas, Iof. 18. 25. à Baasa instau ratur, 1 Reg. 15. 17. destruitur, v. 22. (i. altitudo, excelsa.)
RAMESSES, Ægypti vrbs ab Hebræis ædificatur, Exo. 1. 11. Hinc ab Ægypto discessum auspicantur Israelitis, Num. 33. v. 3 5. (i. tonitruum gaudij.)
RAMOTH Galaad obsidetur, 1 Reg. 22 3. à rege Achabo (i. excelsum signum.)
RANAE super terram Ægypti, Exo. 8. 2. Ps. 78. 45. Apoc. 16. 1.

RAPINA damnatur, Prou. 21 7. & 22. 16. Esa. 33. 1 Ezech. 22. 25. Rapinæ & intemperantiæ nomine intelliguntur, Mal. 23. 25. dapes ex alienis interuersis facultatibus ad luxum comparatæ: Rapinæ & spoliationis exempla: Simeon & Leui Gen. 34. 28. Israelitæ, Exo. 12. v. 35. 36. Deut. 2. v. 32. 35. Amalechitæ, 1 Sam. 30. 16. &c. Dauid, v. 18. 20. populus Israel 2 Sam. 23. 10. Achab. 1 Reg. 21. v. 15. 16. Nabuchodonosor 2 Reg. 24. 13. Philisthæi, 1 Par. 10. 8. exercitus Assiræ regis Par. 14. 13. &c. Iosaphat & populus, 20. 25. Filij Israel, 28. Achaz, v. 21. V. Zacchæus, Luc. 19. 8. Pharisæi, 11. v. 39.
RAPACES fugiendi, 1 Cor. 5. 11. eorum merces, Prou. 28. 10. 21. 7. Esa. 33. 1. 1 Cor. 5. 11. & 6. 10. V. Deut. 28. 31. 58. Nahum 3. 1. Iob. 20. 19. Gen. 6. 11.

RAPTVS est, cùm puellæ, nuptæ, viduæ, libertinæ, necnon pueri rapiuntur à custodia vel parentis, vel tutoris, vel curatoris, vel patroni, vel domini: vt illigitimi coitus habeantur, siue sequatur matrimonium, siue nosgressus habeantur, siue sequatur matrimonium, siue no Qui furatus fuerit hominem, morte multetur: Exo. 21. 16. Raptus infaustus Gen. 6. 2. 7. & 34. 25. V. Plagium.

page.notes: The right edge of the text block is partly obscured by the gutter and by show-through from the facing page; the readings of the cut-off line ends and of the cross-reference column beyond the text are doubtful and have been omitted where not legible. The word "RASI" at the lower right is a catchword-like fragment, not transcribed. Several lines in the middle of the RAPTVS paragraph are doubtful.
